provenance.notes: Model inputs fitted on training years only (2014-2022, 144 fitted county-years in the 22-county model universe). Events are theta_lo = 0.2 qualifying events (runs of 4 h or more after gap bridging, dropouts and the 72 h hours clause), CONTRACTS 1.7. expected_events_per_year = 12 x the Bühlmann-Straub blended monthly rate (county rate blended with its state rate; the between-county variance estimate a is not positive, so k is undefined (null) and every county's credibility weight is 0: each county gets its state's rate). Training theta_lo events per demo county: Harris County, TX: 0, Miami-Dade County, FL: 1, Cook County, IL: 0. Expected payout share = t4 0.6, the only tier paid (CONTRACTS 1.8: the 24-hour tier was cut on 2026-11-12 and is neither paid nor priced). P(24 h | event) stays in backtest.json severity as a report (fitted 0.8147, 34 training events). prob_premises_affected: SPEC 5.5 version 1, the mean share of customers out during training event windows, pooled over all training events (34); the same for every county. risk_margin_rate = cost of capital 0.06 x (1-in-200 simulated annual pool loss - mean loss) / mean loss = 0.06 x (2823000 - 318997) / 318997 (solvency.json). expense_load_cents 100 per member per month. Product parameters set by the humans on 2026-11-12: expense_load_cents 100, cost of capital 0.06, payout_schedule t4 0.6 (60% of cover is a product assumption). Offered (SPEC 5.5, CONTRACTS 1.8): a county is not offered when its priced expected loss is zero because no theta_lo qualifying event exists in its credibility group (its state's model-universe counties) in the fitted training years. Harris County, TX: offered; Miami-Dade County, FL: offered; Cook County, IL: not offered. No outage reached 20% of customers for 4 hours in its pricing group (IL counties with usable data: Cook) in the 2014-2022 data, so there is no history to set a price from. Not-offered counties have no premium and stay in backtest.json and data_quality.json. Premiums this table gives under the CONTRACTS section 4 formula (cents per month, cover 5000/15000/30000): Harris County, TX: 136, 209, 319; Miami-Dade County, FL: 136, 209, 319. Priced case: a member with a registered witness. R2 (no witness, 50% on theta_hi events) is not priced in version 1; its cost is reported in backtest.json.
